critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx:214 — Points card hint text is translated via tr() but the 白银会员 badge in MyAccount shows simplified-chinese '白银会员' while the checkout line uses the raw level.name from backend ('白銀會員' in traditional). The two renderings are inconsistent (same account, two different glyphs) because MyAccount likely runs account-level text through i18n/zh-CN while Checkout prints quote.level.name verbatim. Not a bug for logic, but visually jarring — consider rendering level.name through tr() in both places or returning the already-translated name from the backend consistently.

Checkout.jsx:72 — the /orders/quote POST sends use_points: profile?.points || 0 (full balance) when the toggle is on. Backend caps it, so result is correct, but the UI gives the user no way to spend only part of their points — single toggle is binary. Acceptable for MVP, worth noting as a feature gap vs typical e-commerce 'enter amount to redeem'.

Checkout.jsx:74 — useEffect dep list includes `profile` object identity; every /me/profile re-fetch will refire the quote request. Low-impact (one extra call) but could be narrowed to profile?.points.

Checkout.jsx:123 — order POST sends use_points: profile?.points || 0 (same as quote). If profile has been refetched between quote and submit and points changed (e.g. admin adjusted mid-session), the submitted order may compute a different total than the shown quote. Preview is tiny so unlikely, but worth sending the exact use_points value that was used in the latest quote (quote.points_used) to keep UI and submit in lockstep.
